procedure_name: New Ration Card (APL / BPL / NFSA / Antyodaya)
summary: Issuance of digital household ration card for subsidized food grains and official proof of family tree.

steps.title: Deletion certificate from previous place
steps.description: If moving from another state/town, obtain surrender/deletion certificate from previous food supply office.

steps.title: Gather family member Aadhaar cards
steps.description: Collect Aadhaar numbers and bank account of the eldest female member as Head of the Family (HOD).

steps.title: Submit online NFSA application
steps.description: Fill monthly income, house type (pucca/kutcha), and upload family group photo.

steps.title: Food Inspector field scrutiny
steps.description: Inspector checks economic criteria and verifies family living conditions.

steps.title: Download e-Ration Card
steps.description: Download dynamic QR-code e-Ration Card valid at all Fair Price Shops under One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC).
